contentHtml:
Managing your child's screen time can feel like a losing battle. I make it simple to set up healthy digital habits for the family, screen-time limits, blocking the distracting apps, and keeping an eye on usage across every device, so the kids stay safe and balanced online. I help families around Stretton and Brisbane, onsite or remotely.

Set up at your place or over a remote session

An onsite visit is ideal if you want the whole lot set up in one go, no fuss. A remote session lets me guide you through it step by step from wherever you are. A lot of families get me in to sort the kids' tablets before the school holidays, which is the sensible time to do it.

Every device in the house

I set up and manage parental controls across Apple devices (iPad, iPhone, MacBook), Android phones and tablets, Windows and macOS computers, game consoles and smart TVs, and I can add protection at the wi-fi router so it covers the whole network.

The trusted apps, set up for you

I set up and configure the well-regarded parental control apps, Qustodio, Google Family Link, Microsoft Family Safety, Apple Screen Time and Net Nanny among them, and match the right one to your family rather than pushing a single option. For broader protection around the home, see my computer and network security service.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
